poses.caption: Lie on the side with legs straight and the lower hand under the shoulder, elbow bent.
Press through the lower hand into a straight-arm side plank while extending the top arm upward; lower with control and switch sides after repetitions.

jobs.detail: SIDE PUSH-UP USING BOTTOM ARM, TWO equal SQUARE panels SIDE BY SIDE same model/camera. Lie on LEFT side head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, FRONT three-quarter view showing chest. Both legs straight STACKED, both knees extended, bottom outer shoe grounded. LEFT LOWER: LEFT BOTTOM PALM flat mat under left shoulder fingers forward, left elbow BENT, torso/hip low near mat, RIGHT top arm rests across torso. RIGHT PRESS: LEFT elbow STRAIGHT, push body UP into high side plank supported on LEFT PALM and outer left shoe only, head-shoulders-hips-heels one straight line, hips clearly off mat. RIGHT TOP arm now straight VERTICALLY UP toward ceiling, fingers open, shoulder stacked above left shoulder, chest faces camera. No forearm support, no bent knees, no opposite top hand on floor. Same left supporting hand and leg identity both phases, natural shoulder/elbow alignment. Primary LEFT TRICEPS of SUPPORT arm exposed RED with fine anatomical fibers, secondary arms/chest grayscale, no red cloth needed. Both full poses/hands/shoes inside margins, no bench.

poses.caption: Lie supine with knees bent, feet planted and hands lightly behind the head.
Sit up diagonally, bringing the right elbow toward the left knee while feet stay planted.
Lower slowly, then sit up toward the opposite knee with the left elbow; alternate sides.

jobs.detail: ALTERNATING DIAGONAL SIDE SIT-UP, THREE equal SQUARE panels wide landscape one row. Same high front three-quarter camera, head IMAGE LEFT feet RIGHT, front torso/legs visible. BOTH knees bent and BOTH shoes FLAT floor hip width, feet and pelvis stay fixed same position ALL panels, no knee lift. Hands LIGHTLY behind ears elbows open, no neck pulling. LEFT START: supine full upper back on mat, knees bent up, face ceiling. CENTER: sit torso UP and ROTATE shoulder girdle toward MODEL LEFT so RIGHT elbow approaches LEFT knee, elbow does not need touch, pelvis remains grounded, feet stay flat, torso rises about45degrees. RIGHT: after returning down and rising again, sit UP and rotate shoulder girdle MODEL RIGHT so LEFT elbow approaches RIGHT knee; clearly opposite crossing elbow/knee pair, both feet fixed on floor, no bicycle. Keep hands behind ears, neck follows torso neutral, no arm-only swing. Primary abdominal shirt ONE smooth diffuse BLURRED red teaching tint over intact opaque black fabric, no rays/fibers/sixpack lines. Fine exposed grayscale arms/calves, full opaque front sides back seat crotch. Same limb lengths/camera.
jobs.prompt: Correct original project THREE-panel male ALTERNATING diagonal sit-up. Keep LEFT supine start, CENTER seated twist as is. Both feet remain FLAT planted same positions, knees/pelvis direction unchanged, no whole body mirroring, no knee lifting.
